summary: Ticker and company-name resolution falls back to the EFTS entity index (efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index?keysTyped=...) when www.sec.gov/files/company_tickers.json fails.
reason: www.sec.gov answers HTTP 403 to User-Agents that data.sec.gov and efts.sec.gov accept, so every ticker path (companies lookup/search, cross-section --ticker, ownership) failed even though the --cik paths worked. If both sources fail the error must name both failures.
validated_outcome: With company_tickers.json returning 403 for a generic User-Agent, companies lookup SPCX, companies search apple and cross-section --ticker SPCX,AAPL,GOOGL resolve the right CIKs through EFTS.
